faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani is 20th September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech. in specific engineering fields or an M.Sc. in Electronics, Computer Science, or Physics with at least 60% marks from a recognized university. A valid GATE/NET qualification is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37000 plus HRA. This is a competitive stipend for a research fellowship position.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Where is BITS Pilani located?
faq.answer: BITS Pilani is located in Pilani, Rajasthan. The recruitment is for a position at this campus.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The details regarding the duration of the contract are usually mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with a Master's degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with an M.Sc. in Electronics, Computer Science, or Physics, or an M.E./M.Tech. in relevant engineering disciplines are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
